label: IGH / DUX4

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus involved in B-cell antigen-receptor diversity.

sections.text: DUX4 encodes a double-homeobox transcription factor from a repetitive subtelomeric locus.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 100288687 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: In a primary B-cell precursor ALL cohort, partial DUX4 copies were inserted into IGH and associated with DUX4 overexpression. DNA sequencing confirmed the rearrangements; most characterized products retained both DUX4 homeodomains while truncating its carboxy terminus.

audit_evidence.location: Results, genomic confirmation of DUX4 rearrangements; Figure3, Supplementary Figures2-3, Supplementary Data6/8
audit_evidence.scope: Partial DUX4 copies inserted into IGH; DNA and RNA confirmation, DUX4 overexpression and preserved homeodomains; no obligatory chimeric protein.

report_comment.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus involved in B-cell antigen-receptor diversity. DUX4 encodes a double-homeobox transcription factor from a repetitive subtelomeric locus. In a primary B-cell precursor ALL cohort, partial DUX4 copies were inserted into IGH and associated with DUX4 overexpression. DNA sequencing confirmed the rearrangements; most characterized products retained both DUX4 homeodomains while truncating its carboxy terminus.
